content_text_body:
* Work towards your commitments, check in on progress frequently, be agile and celebrate success.

* Keep having conversations and communicating progress with the team.

* If something didn't work, course-correct quickly and identify 'lessons learned'.

* Make sure your manager/leader is fully apprised of the discussions and actions - enlisting their support as required.

* Stay tuned for the next Glint survey to see how things are improving and evolving.
